body:
## Summary

Implement genuine incremental Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512 synthesis in an extension-owned MV3 Worker. Repair the reviewed flow/HiFT browser graphs, including WebGPU nearest-Resize overflow, and record source, license, runtime, tokenizer, vocoder and SHA-256 provenance for the pinned assets and deterministic local transformations.

## Outcome

- Deliver 24 kHz PCM while speech-token generation is still running, through the existing typed stream and Speaker contracts.
- Reuse shared stream ownership for CosyVoice3 and Qwen3-TTS: ordered utterances, bounded queues, Stop drain, immediate Cancel, teardown and late-reply suppression.
- Prepare verified assets explicitly through Save/Models; Start uses cached assets only under the existing local-only MV3 CSP.
- Preserve Qwen3-TTS, Supertonic3, Kokoro, completed-clip Speaker and manual WAV workflows.
- Document the qualified English/Japanese path, resource limits and unsupported configurations in [the implementation guide](docs/cosyvoice3-streaming.md).

## Validation

The implementation checkpoint records the following results in [the evidence report](docs/evidence/cosyvoice3-172.md), with machine-readable timestamps, prefix comparisons and generated WAVs:

- 782 unit tests, 20 browser TTS tests and 36 selected MV3 regressions passed.
- Extension preparation/build and controlled Qwen3-TTS/CosyVoice3 stream transport checks passed.
- Two real packaged CosyVoice3 checks passed, covering prefix stability and bilingual streaming. One Qwen-only decoder test was skipped as inapplicable; existing other-model real inference was not repeated.
- On Apple M4 Max / 64 GiB, macOS 27.2, Chrome 156 / Metal WebGPU, first nonzero render preceded synthesis completion: English utterances 3323.57/8120.16 ms and 1248.58/4398.02 ms; Japanese 1268.14/7481.67 ms and 1256.21/3453.77 ms.
- Real runs exercised ordered consecutive utterances, Stop, Cancel and offline Start with zero model requests. Shared lifecycle tests cover queue limits, teardown and late replies.
- Sampled aggregate Chrome RSS peaked at 4.48 GiB (English) and 5.11 GiB (Japanese), with two playback underruns per language. These observations do not establish minimum memory or uninterrupted real-time playback. Other GPUs, low-memory/mobile configurations, arbitrary voices/languages and sustained multi-Node operation remain unqualified.

Publication checks confirmed a clean worktree, current-main ancestry and no diff whitespace errors. The implementation-stage inference suites were not rerun during publication.

**Required post-merge verification: pending.** Repeat the real packaged-extension checks against the merged revision with exact asset/runtime pins and recorded hardware. Capture first PCM/render/EOS timing, memory and underruns separately for English/Japanese; verify ordering, bounded queues, Stop/Cancel and offline Start. Expect nonzero render before synthesis completion and no stale playback or Start-time model downloads. Keep #172 open until those results are recorded. This draft is for independent PR review and does not claim completed post-merge verification.

## Related issues

Refs #172

Refs #168; follows #170. Required merged-revision verification remains pending as described above; keep #172 open until those results are recorded.

## Scope check

- [ ] This PR fully addresses each Issue it claims to resolve. Required post-merge verification remains pending.
- [x] This PR does not include unrelated work.
- [x] This PR does not add speculative abstractions, extensibility, frameworks, or subsystems that are not needed by the Issue.
- [x] Any intentionally partial implementation is clearly stated, and the parent Issue is not presented as fully resolved unless the remaining scope has been explicitly split out. Implementation and pre-merge validation are recorded; merged-revision verification remains pending.
- [x] Validation maps to the Issue's expected outcome / acceptance criteria.
